en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide view of an ancient stone amphitheater with concentric rows of seating rising around a circular orchestra. Ruined blocks lie in the foreground, and there is a monumental entrance structure to the right. The caption at the bottom is in Greek and French, identifying the site as the Theatre of Epidaurus. A copyright line and a web address are also visible.
